jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art game VFX animation source sheet. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, match its gritty pixel texture and muted post-apocalypse palette; create NEW effects. Canvas exactly 1536x1024 RGBA genuinely transparent background, no painted backdrop or glow haze outside sprites. Exactly 6 columns and 4 rows, 24 isolated frames, no text, borders, labels, shadows or characters. Each 256x256 cell has fixed effect origin at its center (128,128); keep every visible particle within 90 pixels of that center, leaving clear transparent gutters. Read each row LEFT TO RIGHT as six distinct consecutive keyframes of ONE animation; identical camera top-down slight oblique suitable for MiniDAYZ-style gameplay. Hard pixel clusters, nearest-neighbor look, limited colors, no vector smoothness, no blurry gradients. Last frame must retain a few visible flecks, not be entirely empty. Rows top to bottom: ROW1 compact olive/yellow fungal spore emission, starts small, bursts out, expands then disperses into sparse flecks. ROW2 dense persistent olive-yellow spore cloud SIX-frame seamless breathing/swirl loop with similar total volume, no explosive reset. ROW3 dense fungal cloud dissipating six frames from thick cloud to wisps to a few isolated particles. ROW4 sparse windblown spore trail seamless six-frame loop, wisps drift toward the right and replenish at origin. Distinct silhouettes per row, no fire or orange sparks.
